sharedWait: Shared text is waiting in the input box and will be translated once the network is back.
lite: Lite version – limited. Here you choose who speaks (E/T or the buttons); recognition and voices come from the browser: best in Chrome (computer, Android); Safari (Mac, iPhone) works only with dictation switched on and with limits; Firefox has no speech recognition. Not tested on all devices. The Mac app is much better: detects the language automatically, voice commands, better recognition (Whisper), neural voices, voice profiles, optional translation with Claude. Mac/iPhone app & source code on GitHub
privacy: Privacy: Speech recognition is done by the browser – Chrome sends your audio to Google's servers, Safari to Apple (partly on the device, depending on the device). The recognised text goes to Google Translate (fallback: MyMemory). The Mac app recognises speech on the device instead. Pause and Stop switch the microphone off completely. The phrasebook (below) works without a microphone and offline for English/Thai; in other languages, phrases are sent to Google Translate the first time you tap them (card marked “machine translated”). Study cards (★ saved and, only if switched on, recently translated sentences) stay in this browser only; “Delete all study cards” removes them.
offline: Offline: translation and speech recognition are unavailable right now. The phrasebook with show-cards still works.
localRec: Recognise on this device only (Chrome, not every language)
duplex: Headphones: keep listening while reading aloud (interrupt)
numNote: Haggling? Hand over the device: the amount is shown large in digits and the other person types their own price. Thai number words are machine-generated and not binding.
myNote: Own phrases stay in this browser. Paste the address in Thai script from Maps or from your accommodation; “Take me here” shows it with the sentence for the driver.
name: Name
helpBody:
E or 1 I speak · T or 2 partner speaks · Space or “Stop” ends · P partner view · Esc closes the partner view, otherwise stops. Everything also works without shortcuts using Tab and the buttons.
“Hold to speak”: hold the button, speak, release – handy in noisy places. With the keyboard it stays a toggle.
Voice commands, when English is spoken, as a whole sentence (never translated): “Translator pause” (microphone off – continue with E/T or the button), “Translator repeat”, “slower”, “faster”, “louder”, “quieter”, “clear” (empty history), “help” (this help).
pbMissing: Phrases in {l} are translated the first time you tap them (internet needed), then saved.
statusNet: Speech service not reachable (network?) – trying again …
consentP1: Your browser does the speech recognition: Chrome sends your audio to Google, Safari to Apple. The recognised text goes to Google Translate for translation (fallback: MyMemory). This page has no server of its own.
consentP2: Please do not use it for confidential conversations. Your consent is stored in this browser only.
allergyMt: Thai is machine-made and not checked by native speakers. Have it checked before use. The card does not replace medical information.
learnInfoT: Sentences you mark with ☆ (phrasebook, history) become flashcards: your language on the front, the partner's language on the back. Known = back later (1, 3, 7, 14 days), not known = again right away.
shareAsk: Translate the shared text? It is sent to Google Translate for this.
pbNoMatch: No phrase matches "{q}" – try another word or clear the search.
copyFail: Copying not allowed – please select the text
logClearConfirm: Delete the whole history of this session?
favNone: No favourites in this topic yet – tap ☆ on a phrase.
learnKeys: Keys: space flips · 1 again · 2 hard · 3 knew it · 4 easy (also ← →)
learnDictate: Listening drill: type what you hear
learnResetConfirm: Reset boxes, due dates and statistics of {n} cards? The cards are kept.
learnLimitDone: The daily limit for new cards is reached – more tomorrow.
micDeniedPre: The microphone is blocked for this page. Allow it in the browser's site settings and reload – until then the phrasebook and typing still work.
netBack: Back online: translation and speech recognition work again.
netOffNow: No network: translation is unavailable. Use the phrasebook (works offline) or try again later.
noSw: This browser does not support offline storage – the phrasebook needs a connection.
wipeConfirm: Delete everything this page stored on this device (settings, flashcards, own cards, translations)? This cannot be undone.
sharedNote: Shared text, not checked by the app.
offlinePart: Offline incomplete ({a}/{b}) – reload once with a connection
storageFull: Browser storage full: changes could not be saved. Delete old translations or cards.
dueLine: Today {a} · last 7 days {b} · streak {c} days · box 5: {d}
langTableFail: Language table not loaded – only English/Thai available.
errGenericNote: (for a GitHub report; nothing is sent)
iosWarn: iPhone/iPad: speech recognition in the browser is unreliable there. Better use the iPhone app (folder ios/ in the source code on GitHub). The phrasebook and show cards work well here, though.
noTts: This browser cannot read aloud – translations are only shown.
noVoice: No voice found for {l} – it may not be read aloud. Mac: System Settings → Accessibility → Spoken Content → System Voice → Manage Voices. iPhone: Settings → Accessibility → Spoken Content → Voices. Android: Settings → Text-to-speech → Voice data. Windows: Settings → Time & Language → Add a language.
cmdPaused: ⏸ Paused – microphone off. Continue with E/T or the button
errNotAllowed: Microphone blocked. Please allow it in the browser's site settings (Chrome: icon at the left of the address bar; Safari: settings for this website).
errServiceNotAllowed: Speech recognition not allowed. Safari/iPhone: turn on Dictation (Settings → General → Keyboard → Enable Dictation). Chrome: recognition is blocked in this browser/profile.
errLangNotSupported: This language is not supported by this browser's speech recognition.
errAudioCapture: No microphone found. Please connect a microphone or allow the browser to use it in the system settings, then press again.
errLocalHint: On-device recognition may not be available for this language: turn off the “Only on this device” switch.
noAnswer: Speech recognition is not responding (internet? Chrome needs a connection to Google for it). Please press <kbd>E</kbd>/<kbd>T</kbd> again later – or type or use the phrasebook meanwhile.
statusGoogleDown: Google is unreachable right now, using the fallback service
statusReadyPtt: Ready – hold the button and speak
logTrimmed: Older entries are being removed – use “Save history” if needed
speakOnlyTitle: Read aloud only (without the big view)
pbUnavailable: Phrasebook not available (offline and never loaded?).
learnAllDone: All learned – the next cards are due later.
learnEmpty: No flashcards yet: tap ☆ on a phrase.
learnClearConfirm: Delete all {n} flashcards in this browser?
learnMissing: {m} phrases are missing in {l}: tap them in the phrasebook first (translates them once).
practiceConsent: Please start a microphone mode once first (consent).
practiceHeard: Heard: “{h}” – match {s} %. Recognition is only a rough guide (tones are not checked).
mcFavEmpty: No favourites yet – tap ☆ on a phrase.
mcEmpty: No own cards yet – enter a name and text above and save.
mcTranslated: Translated – correct it by hand if needed
mcTranslateFail: Could not translate – type the text by hand
mcStorageFull: Storage full – nothing saved. Delete old cards or history.
mcNeed: Enter a name and a text
pbSeqHint: Tap cards to select them, then “Show sequence”.
reportConfirm: Report a mistake on this card? A GitHub page opens with prefilled text. Nothing is sent automatically.
printNote: Phrases machine-generated, not checked by native speakers.
printMissing: {m} phrases are missing in this language (tap them in the phrasebook first).
pbWipeConfirm: Delete {n} saved translations in this browser?
preDone: {a} of {b} phrases translated and saved on this device (machine, unchecked).
allergyNoData: Data not loaded (offline and never loaded?)
sharedFail: Shared text not translated (offline or limit).
installApp: Install as an app: faster start, learning progress is kept.
installIos: Tip: Share icon, then “Add to Home Screen” – this keeps flashcards and settings.
noSr: Speech recognition missing: this browser cannot listen (e.g. Firefox). You can still go on: 1. open Chrome or Edge (computer, Android) or Safari (Mac, iPhone, dictation on). 2. Type instead of speaking here. 3. Use the phrasebook – it needs no microphone.
noSrTitle: No speech recognition in this browser – please type or use the phrasebook
favLinkBad: This link does not match the phrasebook.
